metadata.description: Comprehensive UI/UX design resources covering usability, accessibility, design systems, platform guidelines (Apple HIG, Material 3, Android large screens), DTCG design token reports, Core Web Vitals, AI-era UX patterns, demographic-inclusive design, cultural patterns, CRO, and interface simplification for non-technical users
metadata.search_guidance: Prefer official standards and platform docs first, vendor docs second, and treat community articles or inspiration galleries as non-authoritative.

Treat reasoning-effort defaults as version-specific and re-check current OpenAI guidance.

operator_perspectives.name: OpenAI Developers - Designing Delightful Frontends with Codex

Published for a specific Codex model generation; check OpenAI's latest developer blog for the current version.

design_databases_and_tooling.name: UI/UX Pro Max Skill (Next Level Builder)
design_databases_and_tooling.description: Upstream of the vendored offline design database (styles, palettes, font pairings, UX guidelines, stack rules) and BM25 search scripts; MIT licensed
design_databases_and_tooling.notes: Full re-sync 2026-08-17 to upstream a38d04c (v2.0 'Intelligent Design System Generation'). All 13 base CSVs and all 22 stacks/*.csv are verbatim upstream copies EXCEPT typography.csv, which appends two LOCAL rows (75 'Premium Sans (Satoshi · Fontshare)', 76 'Startup Bold (Clash Display · Fontshare)') preserving Fontshare-hosted pairings with working api.fontshare.com URLs after upstream replaced those fonts with Google-importable alternatives (DM Sans; Outfit + Rubik). Upstream deltas absorbed: ux-guidelines +21 rows (WCAG 2.2 focus/target-size/auth + resilient text & compact UI), ui-reasoning +31 product types with new Reasoning/Confidence columns, styles +4 rows (Fluent 2, Shopify Polaris, Adobe Spectrum, Spectrum 2) with new taxonomy columns (Style ID, Aliases, Status, motion cost/risk) that supersede the former local Liquid Glass/motion annotations, colors full contrast overhaul, google-fonts +11 families. Schema changes are additive-only; local forked scripts (core.py/search.py/design_system.py, which add slides/cip domains upstream lacks) read columns by name and remain compatible. Upstream scripts have diverged substantially (core.py 993 lines vs local fork 420, new reasoning_contract.py); script-level reconciliation deliberately deferred.

design_databases_and_tooling.name: Design System Skill (Next Level Builder) — Slide/Deck Data
design_databases_and_tooling.description: Slide-deck design database (layouts, typography, charts, copy formulas, backgrounds, color logic, layout logic, narrative strategies) from the sibling design-system skill in the same upstream repo; MIT licensed
design_databases_and_tooling.notes: Sourced from a DISTINCT upstream skill (design-system) in the same repo, not from ui-ux-pro-max/data. Placed under data/slides/ (rather than flat in data/) to keep provenance visually distinct from the ui-ux-pro-max import, since three different upstream skills now feed this one local data/ tree.

design_databases_and_tooling.notes: Sourced from a DISTINCT upstream skill (design, under its data/cip/ subpath) in the same repo, not from ui-ux-pro-max/data. Placed under data/cip/ (mirroring the upstream subpath name) to keep provenance visually distinct. The upstream cip/ directory also contains a styles.csv, which was intentionally NOT imported (out of approved scope).
